services.name: Public Sunset Tour
services.desc: As of August 1st 2026, our location will be changing. Please click here for more information. Take a Historic and Scenic tour of the Canaveral National Seashore Park in which our experienced Guides will educate you on all of the rich history and historical significance of The Mosquito Lagoon while keeping it light and enjoyable. We’ll also be on the lookout for our wildlife such as dolphin, manatees and various bird life. Then as we make our way back to the dock , listening to a little Jimmy Buffett we typically encounter some of the most vibrant sunsets you’ve ever seen. Arrive 30 minutes before departure time, BOAT LEAVES PROMPTLY ON TIME!!!! No refunds will be given for missed time
